_what: Answer key for the absence survey. NOT under src/, so discovery never reads it. A finding matches an entry when its name (or name+instead) contains EVERY token of one of the entry's token-sets (case-insensitive).

toast.substitute: inline 'Saved 12s ago' / 'Syncing…' text in the header (SyncStatus)

confirm-dialog.substitute: delete is immediate with an inline Undo row (UndoRow)

count-badge.substitute: counts as plain mono parenthetical text '(3 open / 5)'

row-hover.why: --row-hover token is defined and never applied — unfinished, not refused

avatar.why: no users, images or data viz exist to host it

scoring: recall is TWIN-RELATIVE: by the thesis, a 'deliberate' entry is only a real delta when the generated generic twin actually includes it (twin_pattern, case-sensitive regex over the twin source). recall = matched / entries present in the twin; entries absent from the twin are reported as 'not a delta vs this twin'. baseline independence = how many deliberate entries the twin includes at all (a twin that copied the product would include none). errors = any 'present' or 'inapplicable' decoy reported, or an 'accident' decoy reported above low confidence. Built-in registry omissions are neither credited nor penalized.
